privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.body: Provisional document. We collect only the data needed to run the service. ID documents, phone numbers, addresses and banking information are never shown publicly. Payments are processed by a certified provider; we do not store card data. You can request access, correction or deletion of your data by writing to {email}.

terms.title: Terms and conditions
terms.body: Provisional document. {brand} is an intermediary connecting travelers with locals. Each guide is responsible for meeting the legal requirements for their service. Payments and communication must happen on the platform. Harassment, fraud and sharing payment details in messages are prohibited.

cancellation.title: Cancellation policy
cancellation.body: Each guide chooses a policy. Flexible: full refund up to 24 h before. Moderate: full refund up to 48 h before and 50% up to 24 h before. Strict: 50% up to 7 days before. If the guide cancels or declines, the refund is always 100%.

help.title: Help
help.a1: We charge when you book and hold the money. The guide receives it after completing the service. If the guide declines or cancels, you get 100% back.
help.a2: Every guide submits an official ID that our team reviews before their profile goes live.
help.q3: Can I talk to the guide before booking?
help.a3: Yes, use "Send message" on their profile. For safety, phone numbers and emails are hidden in chat.
